## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) — this is how you accept the [CLA](../CLA.md)
- [ ] `ruff check src tests` and `pytest` are green
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavioural changes
- [ ] No real or production data used; no raw row values sent to an LLM
